name: Tam Coc food guide
summary: Tam Coc eats cơm cháy, mountain goat, and nem Yên Mạc in the hamlet, plus mountain snail and a cook-it-yourself meal at Hang Bụt. Thirteen plates are named. Not named: a breakfast dish, a sweet, a drink, a noodle, a second rice, a sausage, and a hotpot as its own Tam Coc plate.
body: This is the boat village, not the Ninh Bình city list. DulichToday, updated 25 January 2024, puts cơm cháy with thịt dê núi and tim cật at restaurants in Tam Coc, and names dê nướng and five ốc núi plates. The 20 December 2016 tourism note still describes Ninh Bình cơm cháy with beef, pork heart and kidney, tomato, carrot, onion, and nấm hương. The 20 October 2023 culture office places that beef plate, and the goat cooking, in thành phố Ninh Bình or the old capital. Beef and shiitake stay. Goat and ruốc stay. Both placements stay.

The 23 May 2023 tourism-center note says lunch is inside the Tam Coc tourist area or nearby, and names cơm cháy, dê núi, and nem Yên Mạc. The 14 May 2025 Tam Coc day names dê tái chanh, cơm cháy, and dê nướng at 11:45, with no restaurant and no street. Nem Yên Mạc stays a Yên Mạc plate and a Yên Mô plate as well as that lunch name. No street is named. A plate price is Check on arrival.

Thirteen plates are named. Not named for Tam Coc: a breakfast dish, a sweet, a drink, a noodle, a second rice, a sausage, and a hotpot as its own Tam Coc plate. A provincial goat list of about more than 20 plates does not mention Tam Coc, so it is not copied here. Miến lươn, cá rô Tổng Trường, nem dê, tiết canh dê, lẩu dê, and dê xào lăn stay with the city or the old capital. Kim Sơn, Gia Viễn, and the other Yên Mô plates stay where they were named.
specialtiesLead: Cơm cháy is the crisp rice. Goat, nem Yên Mạc, mountain snail, and the Hang Bụt meal follow.

sections.heading: Tam Coc specialties
paragraphs: Each line is one plate. Cơm cháy, dê tái chanh, and nem Yên Mạc keep the Ninh Bình sentences and the Tam Coc sentences together. The ốc núi plates are April to August on the DulichToday note. Cá rô nướng, canh cua, and cà muối are the Hang Bụt meal, 1 km from chùa Bích Động on one sentence and in Sơn Hà on the next.
Not named for Tam Coc: a breakfast dish, a sweet, a drink, a noodle, a second rice, a sausage, and a hotpot as its own Tam Coc plate. Hours and a plate price are Check on arrival.
